challenge.back_up: If the guard is wrong, the cost is a red that is not ticketed from a symlinked worktree, the same state a worktree with no commons beside it already has.
challenge.better_approach: Refusing symlinked worktrees outright would break chart doors and hollow runs that use the symlink on purpose; guarding the one red-casting call site is narrower.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a red measured on a branch never belongs in the house commons. A branch red names a proof that may not exist on main, as 1d547c70f1c3 did.
challenge.prior_art: 19193ff1e41e (the hollow has the commons beside it) and 207c4074b3d5 (each test run tickets every new red) are the neighbours; neither guards where the cast lands. StoreUnreachable (red_tickets.py:71) is the existing exit for a store with no git tree.
challenge.real_collision: None with 207c4074b3d5's why (reds don't get lost): the red stays in the run's own record and in the trouble StoreUnreachable already raises.

answers.falsifier: 1: a scratch repo whose CairnCommons is a symlink to a second scratch commons runs ticket_what_is_new over a red, raises StoreUnreachable naming the symlink, and the second commons gains no file. 2: the same symlinked setup still lets a non-red door write through it (cast_ticket into the symlinked store lands), so only red casting is guarded. Wrong intent if a worktree's own reds are meant to land in the house commons.
answers.from_idea: none, because the trigger is a measured failure, not an idea: ticket 1d547c70f1c3 cast into the house commons, its bytes kept at /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cc/0/scratch/akiendelllinux_cc_0/guard/withdrawn-1d547c70f1c3
answers.how: red_tickets._commons_top (the only caller is ticket_what_is_new, red_tickets.py:412) raises StoreUnreachable when the realpath of <repo>.parent/CairnCommons/tickets is not under <repo>.parent/CairnCommons itself, naming the symlink and its target. tester/device.py:949 already catches StoreUnreachable, so the run goes on.
answers.traces_to: Law 6: everything has exactly one owner, and the house commons is not the worktree's to write. Measured 2026-11-19: a wt-93fa reseal cast 1d547c70f1c3 into the house commons and blocked four PROVED closes on working_tree_clean.
answers.what: A tester run casts a red ticket only into the commons that belongs to its own checkout; when <repo>.parent/CairnCommons resolves into another checkout (a symlink), it casts nothing there and the red stays in its own record.

bullets.text: A worktree with CairnCommons symlinked to the house let a tester reseal cast a branch-only red into the house commons and block four PROVED closes; the guard goes at red_tickets._commons_top, its only caller.

title: A tester run casts a red ticket only into the commons that belongs to its own checkout; when <repo>.parent/CairnCommons
